claim_scope: internal/advisor feasibility matrix; qbits is a CRT construction label, not a security level

execution.retention_rule: retain exactly supported measured or warmup rows whose two parties and unchanged post-exit checker pass
execution.aggregate_rule: integer and timing totals are arithmetic sums over retained per-layer rows in the same model/sample_role/trial group

classifier.comparability: preserves the exact ResNet18 1x512x1000 q128/bw32 classifier row and legacy timing column names

all-fc.status: pass only when every selected FC preprocessing row is retained; full_model_status remains fail closed on convolution or truncation gaps

full-model.status: fail closed while any manifest row has ringlpn_status!=supported_untruncated or truncation_status!=supported
